notes: Teaching languages: the programme starts in English and later semesters are partly in German; German A2 is required by the third semester. Tuition: the DAAD page states 500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants and 0 EUR for EU applicants; the 500 EUR corresponds to the DIT service fee for third-country applicants. The application channel is the university's own Primuss portal (de-university-direct); the pages do not mention uni-assist for this programme. Intakes: the only dates found for this programme are 15 Oct - 15 Dec; the pages do not show the year (likely recurring each year for the summer semester). No explicit non-EU-only application deadline is given.
